messages:
carmen: Heads up: customer with M1 images hit a blocker. `pip install redwood-sdk==1.2.3` pulls only manylinux x86_64 wheel, pip falls back to building sdist and that adds ~12m to our image builds. Also mypy flags missing types.

carmen: Repro: macOS arm64 runner, python 3.11, venv -> `pip install redwood-sdk==1.2.3` -> message: `WARNING: redwood_sdk-1.2.3-cp311-cp311-manylinux2014_x86_64.whl is not supported on this platform.` then long build.

jakob: Is the wheel matrix in the release job including macos/universal2? I think we dropped macos in the 1.2.3 workflow.

ops: Also missing `py.typed` in the wheel — type checkers treat package as untyped. We should include that file in packaging.

mira: Workarounds: `pip install git+https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk@main` (our main has arm wheels) or add `--no-build-isolation` if build deps are preinstalled. Not ideal for customers.

jakob: Action items: (1) add `redwood_sdk/py.typed` to MANIFEST.in, (2) re-enable macos universal2 wheel builds in GH Actions, (3) add a release smoke test that installs the wheel on an arm64 mac runner.

ops: I'll open a small release PR with the MANIFEST and CI matrix fix.

ci-bot: Created issue #2450: "packaging: publish mac/universal2 wheels and include py.typed; add arm install smoke test" -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk/issues/2450

carmen: Thanks — can someone ping me when a 1.2.4 wheel is published? I'll re-run the image build and confirm the customer is unblocked. :thanks:
